new_passages.text: The stored value starts at Theta at encoding time zero and wanders until the recall cue at T. Its cue value is x. Later spikes, collected through T plus L, give an estimate x hat of that cue state. Storage error is x minus Theta; readout error is x hat minus x. The estimate is drawn separately from the path endpoint. Under the listed independence, unbiasedness and translation assumptions, total variance is two D T plus readout variance.
